name: Joe Youssef
role: Postdoctoral fellow, AUB MD class of 2026

qa.question: What have you worked on in the lab?
qa.answer: The role of the androgen receptor (AR) in urothelial carcinoma. We showed that patients with AR-positive tumors have about four times the mortality.

qa.question: What drew you to the WAKers?
qa.answer: A supportive environment and a great diversity of research interests.

qa.question: What is a moment in the lab you won't forget?
qa.answer: The nights in the lab working with light-sensitive reagents, with no light at all, natural or artificial. I couldn't see myself :)

qa.question: What would you tell someone about to join?
qa.answer: Follow your heart. The WAKers will help you achieve your dreams.
